name: v0.1.5 — sync to 2026-05 model lineup, Sonnet 4.6 + High effort
body:
## What changed

- Default model bumped: `claude-sonnet-4-5` → `claude-sonnet-4-6`
- Small/fast model split: now defaults to `claude-haiku-4-5` (was Sonnet 4.5 for both)
- New `effortLevel: high` in settings.json (matches Claude Code 2.1.140 picker)
- `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC` flipped to `1` (no updater/telemetry/feedback)
- README documents the full model lineup: opus-4-7 / opus-4-7-1m / sonnet-4-6 / haiku-4-5 / opus-4-6 legacy

## Verified

- 74 unit + component tests pass
- `scripts/verify-gateway.mjs` 6/6 (request hits gateway, Bearer token correct, no cch block, model forwarded)
- Packaged smoke test green
